final_message:
Blog post slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters: "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes all 3 tests, including `test/blog-slug.test.js`.

The fix is in `src/blog/slug.js`. The title is decomposed with `normalize('NFD')` and the combining accent marks are removed before it goes to `slugify`. I didn't touch `vendor/`. The vendor `slugify` drops accented characters entirely, which is why the output was `crme-brle-recipes`.

`src/shop/product-url.js` also calls the vendor `slugify` directly, so product URLs with accented names will still lose those letters. You didn't ask about that, so I left it alone. Say if you want the same normalization applied there.

I haven't committed anything.
